**Finding: compliant (sits at/above fallback).**

Sections 19.1–19.5 together deliver a workable warranty package for us:

- **§19.1** – professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications, with no durational cut-off (well beyond the 30-day services floor).
- **§19.2** – 90 days for each Deliverable, measured from the *later* of delivery or acceptance, and conformity of Hosted Services throughout the subscription term.
- **§19.3** – malicious-code and Applicable Law warranties, plus no functionality diminishment and open-source protection.
- **§19.4** – re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, then terminate-and-refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **§19.5** – disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties.

Only shortfall against the preferred position is the 90-day (rather than 12-month) standalone Deliverable conformity period; given the term-long hosted conformity warranty and the non-exclusive remedy stack, this is noted rather than redlined. No redline proposed.
